automotive-ev-battery.title: Waymo puts Zeekr-built Ojai robotaxis into regular service
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Waymo has begun operating its next-generation robotaxis for paid commercial service, marking a significant milestone in autonomous vehicle deployment. The Zeekr-built electric vans are equipped with Waymo's sixth-generation autonomous driving system and are currently operating in San Francisco, Los Angeles, and Phoenix.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Octillion adds 3 GWh of battery capacity in India
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Octillion Power Systems has opened its third battery manufacturing facility in India with an annual production capacity exceeding 3 GWh. The new Gujarat plant will supply battery systems for electric cars, commercial vehicles, and buses, strengthening India's domestic battery production capabilities.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Renault 5 gains more range and new entry-level LFP version
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Renault has announced technical improvements to its electric Renault 5 that increase driving range while introducing a new entry-level variant powered by LFP battery technology. The expansion of the product line follows recent price reductions and aims to improve market competitiveness in the affordable EV segment.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Is bidirectional AC charging nearing the mass market?
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Leading charging infrastructure providers Cubos, Compleo, and Valeo are focusing on bidirectional AC charging solutions as the pathway to mass-market adoption of vehicle-to-grid technology. The companies envision millions of affordable AC charging points connecting electric vehicles with energy systems, while DC bidirectional solutions are already entering practical deployment.

automotive-ev-battery.title: LKAB deploys 120-tonne electric trucks underground
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Swedish mining company LKAB has successfully deployed two 120-tonne battery-electric Scania trucks at its Malmberget iron ore mine, operating at depths up to 1,250 meters. The vehicles have already transported over 100,000 tonnes of iron ore, demonstrating the viability of heavy-duty electric vehicles in demanding industrial applications.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Einride expands electric freight for Lidl in Sweden
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Electric freight specialist Einride is significantly expanding its transport operations for Lidl in Sweden, with battery-electric trucks now covering 832,000 kilometers annually for the retailer. The expansion includes deployment on longer freight routes, demonstrating growing viability of electric vehicles in commercial logistics.

automotive-ev-battery.title: India: Delhi deploys 200 new electric buses for public transport
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Delhi has added 200 new electric buses to its public transit fleet, bringing the city's total electric bus deployment past the 5,000-vehicle milestone. The continued expansion reflects India's commitment to electrifying urban public transportation and reducing emissions in major metropolitan areas.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Xpeng posts €2.5 billion in revenue in Q2 2026
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Chinese EV manufacturer Xpeng reported second-quarter revenue of approximately €2.5 billion, with growth driven primarily by its strategic partnership with Volkswagen. The company also raised $900 million for its robotics subsidiary Dogotix, signaling expansion beyond traditional automotive into autonomous systems.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Suzuki Unveils it BEV Kei Car for Release This Autumn
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Suzuki has unveiled the e-SKY, its first battery-electric kei car, featuring a reference driving range of 310 kilometers as the Japanese automaker enters the competitive small-car EV segment. The vehicle is scheduled for launch in autumn 2026, targeting Japan's growing demand for affordable electric micromobility.

automotive-ev-battery.title: BYD Malaysia and Bus Cap explore new energy CV platform
automotive-ev-battery.summary: BYD Malaysia and Malaysian bus manufacturer Bus Cap have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to jointly develop a new platform for new energy commercial vehicles. The collaboration aims to accelerate the adoption of electric and alternative-fuel commercial vehicles in Southeast Asia's transportation sector.

science-space.title: NASA Ames' Contributions to Roman's Mission
science-space.summary: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is set to launch on August 30, 2026, and will enable astronomers to explore vast regions of the cosmos while investigating dark energy, dark matter, exoplanets, and galaxy formation. The mission represents a major advancement in space-based astronomy with contributions from NASA Ames Research Center.

science-space.title: NASA's Roman Space Telescope will reveal the universe in a way the JWST and Hubble cannot
science-space.summary: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope will capture images so expansive that no existing screen can display them in their entirety, offering unprecedented perspectives on the cosmos unavailable to current space observatories. This capability distinguishes Roman from other major telescopes like the James Webb Space Telescope and Hubble.

science-space.title: NASA's Pandora Mission Begins Study of Exoplanets, Host Stars
science-space.summary: Pandora, NASA's newest exoplanet mission launched through the Astrophysics Pioneers program, is now conducting observations of worlds beyond our solar system to determine the atmospheric composition of at least 20 exoplanets, including the presence of hazes, clouds, and water. The mission represents a significant advancement in exoplanet characterization capabilities.

science-space.title: Starbase Louisiana: SpaceX announces enormous $100 billion Starbase launch site
science-space.summary: SpaceX has announced plans for a massive new spaceport on Louisiana's Gulf Coast featuring 10 launch pads designed to support thousands of Starship launches annually. This represents a major expansion of commercial spaceflight infrastructure in the United States.

science-space.title: 'You just saved the video dish': Two astronauts complete spacewalk to replace ISS antenna
science-space.summary: Astronauts Anil Menon and Sophie Adenot successfully completed a 6.5-hour spacewalk on August 25, installing a replacement Space-to-Ground antenna on the International Space Station's exterior. The critical repair work demonstrates ongoing international collaboration in maintaining essential ISS infrastructure.

science-space.title: New Next-Gen Dish Adds Muscle to NASA's Deep Space Network
science-space.summary: NASA has added a new 34-meter-wide radio frequency antenna to its Deep Space Network facility in California, enhancing the agency's deep space communications and navigation capabilities. The expanded network continues to support over 40 spacecraft exploring the solar system and interstellar space.

science-space.title: The bubbling surface of doomed supergiant star Betelgeuse has been revealed like never before
science-space.summary: Advanced astronomical observations have captured unprecedented detail of the surface characteristics of the supergiant star Betelgeuse, revealing its dynamic and turbulent structure. The new imagery provides fresh insights into this well-known stellar object and its eventual supernova event.

science-space.title: NASA satellites ace world's 1st 'lost-in-space' GPS-free navigation experiment
science-space.summary: A team of NASA satellites has successfully demonstrated GPS-free navigation techniques, proving the viability of autonomous positioning systems for spacecraft operating without traditional satellite navigation. This breakthrough extends the operational capabilities and mission longevity of orbiting spacecraft.

science-space.title: Sun fires powerful M6.9 solar flare and CME toward Earth — could it boost northern lights chances this week?
science-space.summary: A magnetically active solar region has released a powerful M6.9 solar flare with an associated coronal mass ejection potentially directed toward Earth, which could enhance auroral activity in northern latitudes. The event highlights continued solar activity during the current solar cycle.

science-space.title: Galactic Gems Glisten in New Gallery From NASA's Chandra
science-space.summary: NASA's Chandra X-ray Observatory has released a new image gallery showcasing diverse galaxies across the universe, highlighting the variety of galactic structures including spiral, elliptical, and irregular formations. The collection demonstrates the continued scientific value of X-ray observations in understanding cosmic structures.

world-news.title: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
world-news.summary: Canada has announced retaliatory tariffs of up to 50% on American goods including steel, furniture, fresh tuna, and makeup in escalation of the ongoing US-Canada trade dispute. The measure represents a significant development in North American trade relations with potential macroeconomic implications for both nations.

world-news.title: China hits out at 'illegal' new US sanctions on Iran and trading partners
world-news.summary: China has criticized new US sanctions targeting nations conducting business with Iran, particularly affecting Beijing's significant oil imports from Tehran. The dispute highlights escalating tensions over US enforcement of Iranian sanctions and international trade relationships.

world-news.title: CIA chief travels to Moscow for unannounced talks, US media reports
world-news.summary: Flight tracking data confirms a US military aircraft carrying CIA leadership travelled to Russia from the United States via Latvia, indicating high-level diplomatic engagement between Washington and Moscow. The unannounced visit suggests significant geopolitical discussions are underway between the two powers.

world-news.title: Seven killed in Gaza as Israeli strike 'destroys' aid supply warehouse
world-news.summary: An Israeli military strike destroyed an aid supply warehouse in Gaza, resulting in seven deaths and prompting health ministry warnings of imminent humanitarian collapse in the territory. The incident underscores the escalating humanitarian crisis and ongoing Israeli military operations in Gaza.

world-news.title: Syrian Democratic Forces announce their dissolution
world-news.summary: The Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces announced their dissolution as an independent military force under an agreement reached with the Damascus government. The development marks a significant political and military realignment in Syria's post-conflict reconstruction.

world-news.title: Iran war live: Iran says Hormuz remains closed despite Oman route deal
world-news.summary: Iran stated that the Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed despite reaching an agreement with Oman on alternative shipping routes through the waterway. The statement reflects ongoing tensions regarding regional maritime security and international shipping through critical chokepoints.

world-news.title: Swedish military seeks to take over Russian-owned estate near naval base
world-news.summary: Sweden's armed forces have requested seizure of a Russian-owned property near the Muskö Naval Base, citing security threats posed by Russian drone activity. The action reflects heightened security concerns in Nordic regions following geopolitical tensions with Russia.

world-news.title: European rights court orders Turkey to free imprisoned businessman
world-news.summary: The European Court of Human Rights has ordered Turkey to release philanthropist and activist Osman Kavala after nearly a decade of imprisonment on charges that international rights organizations contend are politically motivated. The ruling underscores tensions between Turkey and European judicial institutions over rule of law concerns.

world-news.title: Lockerbie bombing trial postponed days before it was due to start
world-news.summary: The trial of a Libyan man accused in the 1988 Lockerbie bombing has been postponed for a third time following the emergence of new evidence in the 37-year-old case. The delay highlights the ongoing complexity of international prosecution efforts related to the historic terrorism incident.

world-news.title: Brazil fines TikTok $30m for child data privacy violations
world-news.summary: Brazil imposed a $30 million fine on TikTok's parent company ByteDance for illegally collecting child data, ordering the erasure of improperly obtained information as part of broader regulatory enforcement against technology companies. The action reflects intensifying global efforts to protect children's digital privacy and hold major tech platforms accountable.

finance-markets.title: Canada announces $20bn retaliatory tariffs as US trade war escalates
finance-markets.summary: Canada has announced $20 billion in retaliatory tariffs on hundreds of US goods, effective September 8, in response to escalating trade tensions between the two nations. The move marks a significant escalation in the bilateral trade dispute and threatens to disrupt long-established commercial relationships between the neighbors.

finance-markets.title: The drip-drip US debt crisis
finance-markets.summary: Rising US deficits and escalating debt-servicing costs are failing to prompt fiscal restraint as financial markets and policymakers appear increasingly indifferent to accumulating liabilities. The article examines how traditional market mechanisms for enforcing fiscal discipline have eroded in the current economic environment.

finance-markets.title: US Stock Futures Dip Before Nvidia, Oil Declines: Markets Wrap
finance-markets.summary: US equity index futures declined as investors adopted a cautious stance ahead of Nvidia's earnings announcement, a critical test for confidence in the artificial intelligence investment narrative. Oil prices extended their downward trend, providing some relief to inflation concerns.

finance-markets.title: Xi Signals Defiance as US Threatens Sanctions Over Iran
finance-markets.summary: China's President Xi Jinping has signaled defiance in response to US threats of sanctions over China's economic ties with Iran, demonstrating Beijing's resistance to American pressure on the geopolitical front. The escalating tensions underscore the intersection of trade, sanctions, and great power competition in global finance.

finance-markets.title: Xi's Unprecedented Tax Clawback Hammers Chinese Listed Companies
finance-markets.summary: Chinese listed companies are facing significant financial pressures from unprecedented tax collection efforts by the Xi Jinping administration, with previously stable firms now reporting losses. The development reflects Beijing's aggressive fiscal and regulatory stance toward corporate earnings and capital generation.

finance-markets.title: US affordability tracker: the data that could decide the 2026 midterm elections
finance-markets.summary: The Financial Times is monitoring changes in the cost of living that will significantly influence voter behavior in the 2026 US midterm elections, with affordability metrics emerging as a critical political indicator. The tracking provides real-time insight into consumer economic pressures affecting electoral outcomes.

finance-markets.title: Gold Holds Five-Day Gain as Oil Drop Eases Inflation Concerns
finance-markets.summary: Gold prices maintained a five-day rally as declines in oil prices and US Treasury yields reduced inflation anxiety among investors. Discussions between Iran and Oman regarding shipping corridor reopening contributed to softer energy prices and a reassessment of near-term inflation trajectories.

finance-markets.title: Record Short Bets Hit China's AI Model Duo on Fierce Competition
finance-markets.summary: Bearish positions against Chinese AI companies Z.AI Co. and MiniMax Group Inc. have reached record levels ahead of their earnings reports, reflecting investor concerns about intensifying competition within China's artificial intelligence sector. The short bets signal growing skepticism about valuations and competitive positioning in the rapidly evolving industry.

finance-markets.title: SpaceX commits $100bn to Louisiana space base
finance-markets.summary: SpaceX has committed $100 billion to the development of a second launch complex in Louisiana to support expanded Starship operations and accelerate commercial spaceflight capabilities. The substantial capital investment reflects confidence in the commercial space economy and Elon Musk's broader infrastructure ambitions.

finance-markets.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 26
finance-markets.summary: Oil prices declined for a third consecutive day as Iran and Oman discussed an interim framework to potentially resume shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, a critical global energy chokepoint. The negotiations suggest potential relief from geopolitical supply constraints and support softer commodity pricing.

tech-ai.title: OpenAI loses a top data center exec, as stream of high-profile departures continues
tech-ai.summary: OpenAI's Vice President of Infrastructure Malone has departed the company, marking another significant executive exit amid organizational restructuring. The departure follows a recent reshuffling of OpenAI's infrastructure organization, with reporting lines shifted away from President Greg Brockman to Vice President Sachin Katti.

tech-ai.title: Stability AI, maker of image generator Stable Diffusion, raises $76 million in fresh funding
tech-ai.summary: Stability AI has secured $76 million in new funding, bringing its total fundraising to $232 million as the company continues to develop its generative AI image technology. The funding round underscores continued investor confidence in the generative AI sector despite market competition.

tech-ai.title: Claude Cowork finally remembers what you told the app in chat
tech-ai.summary: Anthropic has implemented shared memory functionality across Claude chat and Cowork, allowing users to maintain context and project information without repetitive briefing. The feature represents a significant usability enhancement for AI assistants in professional workflows.

tech-ai.title: Waymo robotaxis are headed to Munich
tech-ai.summary: Waymo is expanding its autonomous vehicle operations to Munich, capitalizing on Germany's favorable regulatory environment for autonomous vehicle testing and commercial deployment. The move signals continued global expansion of robotaxi services beyond the United States.

tech-ai.title: X sends cease-and-desist to open source project Nitter over alleged scraping
tech-ai.summary: X has issued cease-and-desist letters to Nitter, the open source project providing privacy-focused alternatives to X's official platform, demanding the shutdown of its instances and code repositories over scraping allegations. The action reflects ongoing tensions between social media companies and open source projects accessing their data.

tech-ai.title: SpaceX will build a second, $100B 'Starbase' spaceport in Louisiana
tech-ai.summary: SpaceX announced plans to construct a second major spaceport in Louisiana with an estimated investment of $100 billion, with construction beginning in 2027 and potential Starship launches as early as 2029. The expansion represents a significant capital commitment to increase launch capacity and redundancy for the company's space operations.

tech-ai.title: Instagram's 'First Draft' feature aims to make editing Reels less tedious
tech-ai.summary: Instagram is rolling out First Draft, an AI-powered feature that automatically generates edited Reels compilations from multiple video clips in under 10 seconds. The tool aims to streamline video creation and make content production more accessible to creators without extensive editing experience.

tech-ai.title: Trump is upping the price of Big Tech's favorite visa
tech-ai.summary: The Department of Homeland Security announced implementation of a $103,000 fee increase on H-1B visas while the State Department plans to revoke visas for up to 200,000 asylum seekers, marking potentially the largest mass visa revocation in U.S. history. The policy changes significantly impact technology sector hiring practices and immigration landscape.

tech-ai.title: Garmin's new Fenix 9 adds brighter screens and smoother map panning
tech-ai.summary: Garmin unveiled its Fenix 9 smartwatch line featuring OLED displays with brightness up to 3,000 nits—double its predecessor—along with 50 percent more RAM, 64GB storage, and an upgraded map engine for faster navigation. The base model starts at $999.99 and includes sapphire lens protection and enhanced software capabilities.

tech-ai.title: Nothing OS 5.0 brings a new Glyph Interface app and a more customizable homescreen
tech-ai.summary: Nothing OS 5.0 introduces adaptive color technology allowing app icons and widgets to dynamically match wallpaper colors while maintaining the platform's signature monochrome aesthetic. The update provides users with customization options that blend the company's minimalist design philosophy with personalization features.

health-biotech.title: Pennsylvania reports first 2 measles deaths in the U.S. this year, both people unvaccinated
health-biotech.summary: Two unvaccinated Pennsylvania residents have died from measles, marking the first measles-related deaths in the United States in 2026. The deaths underscore ongoing public health concerns regarding vaccine hesitancy and measles transmission among unprotected populations.

health-biotech.title: Roche, Eli Lilly get FDA nod for new Alzheimer's blood test
health-biotech.summary: Roche and Eli Lilly have received FDA approval for a new Alzheimer's blood test, with Labcorp and Quest Diagnostics planning to offer the diagnostic. The test, which previously secured CE mark certification in Europe, represents a significant advancement in early Alzheimer's detection and screening capabilities.

health-biotech.title: FDA approves Jazz's Ziihera in frontline gastric cancer
health-biotech.summary: Jazz Pharmaceuticals' bispecific antibody Ziihera has received FDA label expansion approval for frontline treatment of HER2-positive gastroesophageal adenocarcinomas, significantly broadening its market potential beyond previous indication restrictions. The approval marks the first use of Ziihera in newly diagnosed gastric cancer patients following its 2024 approval for certain advanced cases.

health-biotech.title: J&J's Imaavy wins label expansion; Two approvals in Japan
health-biotech.summary: Johnson & Johnson's monoclonal antibody Imaavy has secured label expansion approval, becoming the first treatment specifically approved for warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia, a rare autoantibody disease characterized by severe anemia and fatigue. The drug also received regulatory approvals in Japan, expanding its global reach.

health-biotech.title: Sword Health to acquire Headspace, according to filing
health-biotech.summary: Digital health company Sword Health has announced plans to acquire mental health services provider Headspace, according to regulatory filings, combining two major digital health unicorns. The acquisition would significantly expand Sword Health's service offerings into the mental health sector.

health-biotech.title: Amgen, academic centers weigh new FDA pilot to speed early drug trials
health-biotech.summary: The FDA and stakeholders including Amgen and Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center are developing a pilot program to accelerate first-in-human trials in response to competitive pressures from China and Australia's dominance in expedited early-phase trial timelines. The initiative aims to strengthen the U.S. biotech sector's competitive position in drug development.

health-biotech.title: Regenxbio hit with another clinical hold for Hunter syndrome gene therapy
health-biotech.summary: Regenxbio announced it no longer expects near-term FDA approval filing for its Hunter syndrome gene therapy following a second clinical hold this year. The regulatory setback raises questions about the program's viability and the company's development timeline.

health-biotech.title: FDA promises new AI guidance, and what happened at Epic's UGM
health-biotech.summary: The FDA has announced plans to develop new regulatory guidance for generative AI-powered medical devices as part of broader artificial intelligence governance initiatives. The announcement reflects increasing regulatory focus on establishing clear standards for AI applications in healthcare and medical technology.

health-biotech.title: How Trump's funding cuts are reshaping the health system
health-biotech.summary: STAT News examines how Republican healthcare funding cuts are reshaping the U.S. health system while reporting on developments in mRNA science and Medicaid's evolving drug coverage denial strategies. The analysis covers significant policy implications for healthcare infrastructure and pharmaceutical access.

health-biotech.title: Bristol Myers ends deal with Cellares, cell therapy manufacturer to reorg
health-biotech.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb has terminated its partnership with cell therapy manufacturer Cellares following a comprehensive evaluation, determining that the Cellares Cell Shuttle system did not meet strategic objectives. The separation will trigger reorganization at Cellares as the company reassesses its business direction.

crypto-web3.title: U.S. state banking associations plan to launch their own nationwide blockchain network
crypto-web3.summary: The "BankChain Alliance" represents a significant institutional push to integrate blockchain technology within regulated banking frameworks, with plans to launch in 2027. The initiative aims to facilitate stablecoins, payments, and tokenized deposits while maintaining compliance with existing banking regulations.

crypto-web3.title: LayerZero unveils trading infrastructure for crypto and tokenized markets, ZRO surges
crypto-web3.summary: LayerZero launched ATLAS, a new trading infrastructure platform built on its Zero blockchain that serves both crypto and tokenized asset markets. The platform is backed by Citadel Securities and has garnered interest from institutional players including the DTCC and ICE.

crypto-web3.title: Franklin Templeton partners with HashKey to offer tokenized money market fund in Asia
crypto-web3.summary: Franklin Templeton expanded its tokenized asset offerings by launching the Franklin OnChain US Government Liquidity Fund through HashKey's platform in Asia. This partnership marks another major institutional adoption of blockchain-based fund distribution in emerging markets.

crypto-web3.title: South Korea trade giant POSCO brings trade receivables to Avalanche in latest tokenization move
crypto-web3.summary: POSCO, a $22 billion Korean trading company, tokenized its trade receivables on the Avalanche blockchain in collaboration with Olea and Intain. This transaction demonstrates growing adoption of blockchain-based tokenization for real-world business assets in major economies.

crypto-web3.title: Bitwise turns Coinbase's tokenized stocks into automated AI, robotics and tech portfolios
crypto-web3.summary: Bitwise launched automated portfolio management products using Coinbase's tokenized stocks, offering thematic exposure to sectors including artificial intelligence, robotics, and the Magnificent Seven. The offering represents innovation in on-chain asset management as tokenization creates new investment structuring opportunities.

crypto-web3.title: Blockchain Association backs Treasury's proposed GENIUS Act rules for stablecoin issuers
crypto-web3.summary: The Blockchain Association endorsed the Treasury Department's proposed GENIUS Act regulatory framework for stablecoin issuers, while advocating for refined implementation details. The endorsement supports limiting client identification requirements to direct issuer-customer transactions in the primary market.

crypto-web3.title: Zerohash back for second effort at OCC trust bank charter
crypto-web3.summary: Crypto infrastructure firm Zerohash filed for a second attempt at obtaining an OCC trust bank charter after failing in its initial application. The company is pursuing a narrower approach in this revised submission.

crypto-web3.title: Galaxy expands retail crypto lending with new BTC, ETH and SOL-backed credit line
crypto-web3.summary: Galaxy introduced a new crypto-backed portfolio line of credit allowing GalaxyOne clients to borrow cash against Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana holdings without liquidating positions. The offering expands institutional-grade lending services to qualified retail investors.

crypto-web3.title: Chainalysis-run sting targets child exploitation networks with aid of Binance, Coinbase
crypto-web3.summary: Operation Lighthouse, a law enforcement initiative led by Chainalysis in cooperation with Binance and Coinbase, disrupted child exploitation networks and generated over 14,000 investigative leads. The operation demonstrates the crypto industry's collaboration with authorities on combating serious financial crimes.

crypto-web3.title: Grayscale debuts first Zcash ETF of its kind as privacy coin surges
crypto-web3.summary: Grayscale launched the first exchange-traded fund providing direct exposure to Zcash, the privacy-focused cryptocurrency. The product launch coincided with increased market interest in privacy-oriented digital assets.

cybersecurity.title: Microsoft Patches a Record 570 Security Flaws
cybersecurity.summary: Microsoft released updates addressing at least 570 security vulnerabilities across its Windows operating systems and software, nearly tripling the previous month's record-setting patch count. The company attributed the surge to enhanced vulnerability discoveries powered by artificial intelligence tools.

cybersecurity.title: Actively Exploited Oracle WebLogic Flaw Lets Unauthenticated Attackers Access Critical Data
cybersecurity.summary: CISA added a maximum-severity flaw in Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle WebLogic Server to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, with a perfect CVSS score of 10.0. The vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers with network access to gain unauthorized access to critical data through HTTP.

cybersecurity.title: Mirage2FA Surge Hits 4,500 US and EU Companies, Abusing Microsoft 365 Login Flows
cybersecurity.summary: A phishing-as-a-service campaign has affected thousands of organizations from 2024 to 2026 by targeting Microsoft 365 accounts through legitimate login flow abuse and two-factor authentication bypass. Research indicates that 48 percent of targeted email addresses were potentially compromised, with the majority of affected companies based in the United States.

cybersecurity.title: FBI Seizes NetNut Proxy Platform, Popa Botnet
cybersecurity.summary: The FBI coordinated with industry partners to seize hundreds of domains associated with NetNut, a residential proxy service operated by publicly-traded Israeli company Alarum Technologies. The action follows security firm findings linking NetNut to the Popa botnet, which has compromised at least two million devices.

cybersecurity.title: Attackers Target miniOrange SAML Flaws That Can Grant WordPress Admin Access
cybersecurity.summary: Threat actors are actively exploiting two severe unauthenticated authentication bypass vulnerabilities in the miniOrange SAML 2.0 Single Sign On plugin for WordPress. The flaws enable attackers to sign in as any WordPress user, including administrators, with CVE-2026-61979 rated at CVSS 8.1.

cybersecurity.title: A Malicious Webpage Could Poison Your Local AI Model Behind NVIDIA NemoClaw
cybersecurity.summary: Oasis Security disclosed a vulnerability in NVIDIA NemoClaw that allows attacker-controlled webpages to gain unauthenticated control over local Ollama instances and inject hidden instructions into AI models. The finding was reported to NVIDIA's Product Security team prior to public disclosure.

cybersecurity.title: Scattered Spider Hackers Plead Guilty on Day 1 of Trial
cybersecurity.summary: Two members of the prolific Scattered Spider cybercrime group pleaded guilty in the United Kingdom to charges related to an August 2024 cyberattack that disrupted Transport for London's public transportation network. Their guilty pleas came on the first day of what was anticipated to be a six-week trial.

cybersecurity.title: 24 npm Packages Abuse unpkg Mirrors to Host Fake Cloudflare CAPTCHA Pages
cybersecurity.summary: Researchers uncovered a campaign utilizing 24 npm packages as free phishing infrastructure to redirect users to fake CAPTCHA pages in ClickFix-style attacks. Rather than targeting developers, threat actors exploited npm's ecosystem to host malicious HTML pages for credential harvesting.

cybersecurity.title: U.S. Sanctions Iran-Linked Hackers Behind Critical Infrastructure Breaches
cybersecurity.summary: The U.S. Department of the Treasury announced fresh sanctions against Iranian cyber actors as part of a coordinated government-wide economic campaign against the nation. The action targets the financial connections and enablers of state-sponsored threat actors involved in critical infrastructure attacks.

cybersecurity.title: Felons, Fraudsters Flog Offensive Cybersecurity Startup
cybersecurity.summary: A cybersecurity startup offering millions to acquire zero-day vulnerabilities is operated by far-right conspiracy theorists and convicted felons with histories of running fake intelligence companies and defunct AI platforms under aliases. The venture raises significant concerns about the legitimacy and oversight of vulnerability acquisition programs.

startups-vc.title: Self-driving truck startup Gatik raises $200M following PepsiCo deal
startups-vc.summary: Autonomous trucking startup Gatik has secured $200 million in funding, its largest round to date, led by Qatar Investment Authority and Koch Disruptive Technologies. The funding follows a strategic partnership with PepsiCo, validating the company's technology in logistics and supply chain applications.

startups-vc.title: Which Investors Have Backed The Most 2026 Unicorns?
startups-vc.summary: A record 250 companies have achieved unicorn status through mid-August 2026, up from 193 in 2025, with robotics, AI labs, healthcare, biotech, and AI infrastructure leading the sectors. The analysis identifies top-performing investors capitalizing on the 2026 funding surge across emerging technology categories.

startups-vc.title: Accel-backed Keenable is indexing the web for AI agents
startups-vc.summary: Keenable, an Accel-backed startup, has exited stealth with a $26 million seed round to build a specialized web search index optimized for AI agents. The funding positions the company to capitalize on the growing infrastructure needs of autonomous AI systems.

startups-vc.title: India's Airbound bags $37M to take on trucks with rocket-like drones
startups-vc.summary: Indian drone delivery startup Airbound has raised $37 million from investors including Greenoaks, DoorDash, and Silicon Valley investor Lachy Groom. The company's ultra-lightweight drone technology targets the last-mile delivery market as an alternative to traditional trucking.

startups-vc.title: Inside The Private-Market Divide: EquityZen's Phil Haslett On AI, SaaS And Secondaries
startups-vc.summary: EquityZen co-founder Phil Haslett discusses how secondary markets have become integral to the startup ecosystem, with startups increasingly offering early liquidity to employees and investors. Secondary market pricing often provides more accurate valuation signals than headline funding announcements.

startups-vc.title: Fitbit founders launch Luffu Link, an LTE health and safety band
startups-vc.summary: Former Fitbit founders have launched Luffu Link, a wearable device combining health sensing, voice logging, location tracking, and emergency assistance capabilities without requiring a smartphone. The LTE-enabled band targets health-conscious consumers seeking independent connectivity and safety features.

startups-vc.title: Why Bootstrapped Businesses Are More Relevant Than Ever
startups-vc.summary: Bootstrapped startups are gaining relevance in the startup ecosystem as an alternative to venture capital, prioritizing profitability and customer validation over external funding. The traditional VC model funds speculative product-market fit searches, while bootstrapped founders begin with proven customer problems and achieve steady growth through revenue.

startups-vc.title: When Should A Board Consider Selling A Company?
startups-vc.summary: Strategic adviser Itay Sagie outlines key signals boards should monitor to evaluate exit opportunities alongside scaling strategies, including strong company performance, shifting founder priorities, and strategic buyer interest. Effective boards continuously reassess whether selling aligns with stakeholder objectives rather than defaulting to perpetual growth.

startups-vc.title: The 3 New Pricing Models in B2B. Pick One, Because The Old One (Just Seats) Really is Dying
startups-vc.summary: ZoomInfo CEO Henry Schuck analyzes the evolution of B2B SaaS pricing models beyond traditional per-seat licensing, noting that industry experts and customers lack consensus on emerging pricing strategies. The analysis suggests that static pricing approaches are becoming obsolete and companies must proactively adapt their models.

startups-vc.title: Andy Dunn's startup Pie becomes less of an events app and more of a social network
startups-vc.summary: Bonobos co-founder Andy Dunn's Pie app is expanding beyond its original events-focused positioning to function as a social network for group organization and connection. The pivot reflects evolving user behavior and market demand for broader social coordination capabilities.

energy-climate.title: Q&A: What is 'long-duration energy storage' – and why does the UK need it?
energy-climate.summary: The UK is pioneering the deployment of long-duration energy storage systems, often referred to as 'super batteries,' to address the intermittency challenges of renewable energy sources. These systems are critical for smoothing power output and ensuring grid stability as the country transitions to higher renewable energy penetration.

energy-climate.title: Factcheck: How nuclear, gas, wind and solar power are affected during heatwaves
energy-climate.summary: Climate change is increasing the frequency and intensity of heatwaves, which have significant impacts on multiple forms of power generation worldwide. The analysis examines how nuclear, fossil fuel, wind, and solar systems are differentially affected by extreme heat events.

energy-climate.title: Irish electricity generation by grid-scale PV up 51% in 2025
energy-climate.summary: Grid-scale solar farms in Ireland generated 1.1 GWh of electricity in 2025, representing a 51% increase from 2024 and accounting for 4% of total electricity supply. The data demonstrates rapid renewable energy deployment while coal generation declined by 52 percent year-over-year.

energy-climate.title: ArcLight invests $1bn to launch independent transmission company
energy-climate.summary: ArcLight Capital has committed $1 billion to establish Anchor Point Transmission, a new independent transmission company designed to strengthen US power grid infrastructure and support renewable energy integration. This major investment reflects growing focus on grid modernization to accommodate distributed renewable resources.

energy-climate.title: Van Oord installs all 111 monopiles for Baltica 2 wind farm
energy-climate.summary: Marine contractor Van Oord has completed installation of all 111 monopiles for the 1.5 GW Baltica 2 offshore wind farm in Poland, marking a significant milestone in the project's development. This major offshore wind infrastructure project demonstrates continued European investment in large-scale renewable energy capacity.

energy-climate.title: Portugal's largest solar plant enters administration amid low output, falling power prices
energy-climate.summary: Portugal's 220 MW Solara4 solar plant, owned by Welink Energy Portugal 2 UK, has entered administration due to weak generation performance, depressed wholesale power prices, technical issues, and rising operational costs. The situation highlights financial pressures facing utility-scale solar projects in markets with declining electricity prices.

energy-climate.title: Avantus secures $300m in tax equity for Aratina 2 solar storage project
energy-climate.summary: Avantus has secured $300 million in tax equity financing from Truist Bank to support development of the Aratina 2 solar and storage project. The investment demonstrates continued financial interest in combined solar-storage systems that provide both generation and grid services.

energy-climate.title: Greece introduces new spatial planning rules for PV
energy-climate.summary: Greece has implemented updated spatial planning regulations for renewable energy and storage projects, establishing stricter siting criteria and expanding protected areas while capping PV land use at 1.5% per regional unit. The framework aims to balance renewable energy deployment with environmental and land-use considerations.

energy-climate.title: Sweden could face 150,000 metric tons of end-of-life panels annually
energy-climate.summary: A new industry roadmap warns that Sweden's annual solar panel decommissioning could increase from 17 metric tons in 2021 to approximately 150,000 metric tons by 2060. The projection raises concerns about whether current recycling and reuse infrastructure can adequately handle the coming wave of end-of-life solar panels.

energy-climate.title: Sharp unveils 11.5 kWh battery for residential use
energy-climate.summary: Sharp has launched its Japan-made Eee Storage battery offering 11.5 kWh capacity in a compact 35% smaller footprint compared to previous models, with integrated AI-powered energy management and enhanced backup capabilities. The product advances residential energy storage technology with improved efficiency and grid services capabilities.

asia-pacific.title: What is really behind Japan's planned cabinet shake-up?
asia-pacific.summary: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is preparing a cabinet reshuffle in mid-to-late September despite declining poll numbers, aimed at strengthening her coalition government and rewarding ruling party lawmakers. The restructuring is expected to boost voter confidence, secure support from junior coalition partner Ishin no Kai, and consolidate Takaichi's political position amid domestic challenges.

asia-pacific.title: How an Election in Okinawa Will Impact East Asian Security
asia-pacific.summary: An upcoming election in Okinawa featuring incumbent Governor Denny Tamaki, known for his opposition to U.S. military bases, will have significant implications for regional security dynamics and the U.S.-Japan alliance. The outcome could influence broader East Asian geopolitical alignments and defense cooperation frameworks.

asia-pacific.title: Hong Kong's property, financial markets face test under cross-border anti-corruption law
asia-pacific.summary: China's proposed sweeping cross-border anti-corruption law, submitted for legislative deliberation, poses potential implications for Hong Kong's financial and property markets as Beijing seeks harsher penalties for corrupt officials and expanded oversight of overseas wealth transfers. The legislation could significantly impact capital flows and asset management practices in Hong Kong's key economic sectors.

asia-pacific.title: What the Latest '2+2' Dialogue Tells Us About China-Indonesia Relations
asia-pacific.summary: China has signaled its intent to expand influence in Indonesia's defense sector through recent diplomatic dialogues, prompting Jakarta to carefully evaluate whether such deepened military cooperation aligns with Indonesian national interests. The engagement reflects broader strategic competition in Southeast Asia and shifting security partnerships.

asia-pacific.title: China's Strategic Plan for Space Superiority
asia-pacific.summary: China is implementing a comprehensive strategy to achieve space superiority by developing space logistics infrastructure and capabilities tailored to support potential military operations. The initiative reflects Beijing's recognition of space as a critical domain for future strategic competition and conflict.

asia-pacific.title: China's 'Three-Anti' Legal Framework in Action
asia-pacific.summary: China's suite of laws targeting foreign sanctions, intervention, and extraterritorial jurisdiction is reshaping cross-border business practices and intensifying geopolitical competition with Western nations. The framework demonstrates Beijing's strategic effort to counteract foreign policy tools while protecting domestic interests.

asia-pacific.title: Taiwan: A Growing Economic Partner for the EU in Troubled Times
asia-pacific.summary: Taiwan and the European Union are developing increasingly robust economic and strategic ties that function as a de facto partnership despite the absence of formal diplomatic recognition. The relationship reflects shared interests in addressing global supply chain vulnerabilities and geopolitical stability amid cross-strait tensions.

asia-pacific.title: No immunity: how Xi's anti-corruption fighters are zeroing in on fresh targets
asia-pacific.summary: A major investigative project reveals that President Xi Jinping's anti-corruption campaign continues to target officials across provinces and after retirement, demonstrating the campaign's comprehensive reach and lack of geographic or temporal boundaries. The initiative reflects Xi's consolidation of power through systematic elimination of potential rivals and enforcement of party discipline.

asia-pacific.title: Pakistan Passes Legislation to Formalize New Military Command Structure
asia-pacific.summary: Pakistan has enacted legislation to operationalize structural reforms within its armed forces that have been incrementally implemented over the past year. The formal codification of these changes reflects broader institutional evolution within Pakistan's military hierarchy and command systems.

asia-pacific.title: India's Gen Z Protests: When Youth Rage Becomes a Beacon of Hope
asia-pacific.summary: Recent Generation Z-led protests in India have revitalized democratic participation and restored civic spaces that had contracted over the past decade. The youth-driven activism signals renewed engagement in democratic processes and civic governance at a critical juncture for Indian democracy.
